about.title.description: Settings › About: the heading of the section about Flown.

about.version.description: Settings › About: the app version under its name; {version} is a version number such as 0.7.1.

about.builtBy.description: Settings › About: who makes Flown, before a link to their website; {company} is the company name (Qbexel), never translated.

dialog.close.description: Settings: the accessible name of the close (×) button in the dialog’s header.

storage.shared.description: Settings › Storage, a recording’s details: how much of its disk use it shares with a copy of the project (Duplicate links the media). {size} is a size such as "1.9 GB".

storage.title.description: Settings › Storage: the heading of the section on disk use and clean-up.

storage.measuring.description: Settings › Storage: shown while the disk use is measured.

storage.total.description: Settings › Storage: the disk use of all recordings, the size in bold. {size} is a size such as "95 KB".

storage.free.description: Settings › Storage: follows "Recordings use …" when the free space is known; {free} is a size. Starts with a space and a middle dot.

storage.empty.description: Settings › Storage: there are no recordings to list.

storage.listLabel.description: Settings › Storage: the accessible name of the list of recordings, largest first.

storage.used.description: Settings › Storage: when a recording was made and when it was last used. {date} is a date ("12 Mar 2026"), {when} a relative day ("today", "yesterday", "3 days ago").

storage.unfinished.description: Settings › Storage: a recording that was never finished (it has no date to show).

storage.cache.description: Settings › Storage, a recording’s details: how much of its size is cache Flown can rebuild. "incl." is short for including.

storage.versions.description: Settings › Storage, a recording’s details: the disk use of its saved versions.

storage.atLeast.description: Settings › Storage: a recording’s size when measuring stopped early (very many files).

storage.showLabel.description: Settings › Storage: the accessible name of a recording’s Show button; {name} is the project’s name.

storage.showFewer.description: Settings › Storage: the link that shortens the list of recordings again.

storage.showAll.description: Settings › Storage: the link that lists every recording; {n} is how many there are (more than 8).

storage.rules.description: Settings › Storage: the heading of the automatic clean-up rules.

storage.cacheDays.description: Settings › Storage: label of a menu of day counts ("30 days") or Off.

storage.days.description: Settings › Storage: a choice in the clean-up menus; {n} is 14 to 365 days.

storage.auto.description: Settings › Storage: checkbox that clears the caches by the rule without asking.

storage.removeDays.description: Settings › Storage: label of a menu of day counts or Off; recordings go to the Recycle Bin only after the user confirms.

storage.hint.description: Settings › Storage: the note under the clean-up rules.

storage.review.description: Settings › Storage: button that lists what the rules would clean up before anything moves.

storage.reviewTitle.description: Settings › Storage: the heading of the list of what would be cleaned up.

storage.nothing.description: Settings › Storage: the rules find nothing to clean up.

storage.groupRemove.description: Settings › Storage, the review: the heading of the recordings the rules would move to the Recycle Bin, how many and their size.

storage.groupCaches.description: Settings › Storage, the review: the heading of the recordings whose caches the rules would clear, how many and the size freed.

storage.move.description: Settings › Storage, the review: the button that moves the ticked items; {n} is how many are ticked.

storage.moved.description: Settings › Storage: the result of a clean-up, how many items moved and the space freed.

storage.nothingMoved.description: Settings › Storage: the result of a clean-up that moved nothing.

storage.failedCaches.description: Settings › Storage: a clean-up step that failed; {name} is the project’s name, {reason} the error.

storage.failed.description: Settings › Storage: a recording the clean-up could not move; {name} is the project’s name, {reason} the error.

diagnostics.title.description: Settings › Diagnostics: the heading of the section with the report for support.

diagnostics.hint.description: Settings › Diagnostics: what the report holds and leaves out. "Keys" are the user’s API keys.

diagnostics.collecting.description: Settings › Diagnostics: the button while the report is being made.

diagnostics.show.description: Settings › Diagnostics: the button that makes and shows the report.

diagnostics.openLogs.description: Settings › Diagnostics: opens the folder of the app’s log files.

diagnostics.report.description: Settings › Diagnostics: the accessible name of the box that shows the report (the report itself stays English).

diagnostics.copy.description: Settings › Diagnostics: copies the shown report to the clipboard.

diagnostics.stale.description: Settings › Diagnostics: the report shown was replaced in main, so Copy refused it.

localAi.downloadName.description: Settings › AI on this PC: what a model’s Download button says to a screen reader; {title} is the model’s title ("Recommended"), {size} its size in gigabytes.

localAi.progress.description: Settings › AI on this PC: a download’s progress beside its bar; {done} is gigabytes downloaded ("1.2"), {total} the model’s size ("3.1 GB").

localAi.progressValue.description: Settings › AI on this PC: what a download’s progress bar says to a screen reader.

localAi.title.description: Settings › AI on this PC: the heading of the section of AI models that run on the user’s PC.

localAi.lead.description: Settings › AI on this PC: what AI on this PC does. "No key": no API key is needed.

localAi.checking.description: Settings › AI on this PC: shown while the PC’s memory and graphics are checked.

localAi.failed.description: Settings › AI on this PC: the check of the PC failed.

localAi.ready.description: Settings › AI on this PC: announced to screen readers when a model’s download ends; {title} is the model’s title.

localAi.use.description: Settings › AI on this PC: the heading of the choice of model to use (Automatic or one downloaded model).

localAi.automatic.description: Settings › AI on this PC: let Flown pick the model.

localAi.suggested.description: Settings › AI on this PC: badge on the model that suits this PC best.

localAi.downloaded.description: Settings › AI on this PC: badge on a model that is on this PC.

localAi.damaged.description: Settings › AI on this PC: a model’s file failed its check.

localAi.downloading.description: Settings › AI on this PC: the accessible name of a download’s progress bar.

localAi.removeQuestion.description: Settings › AI on this PC: the question before a downloaded model is removed; {size} is its size ("3.1 GB").

localAi.downloadAgain.description: Settings › AI on this PC: downloads a damaged model again.

localAi.download.description: Settings › AI on this PC: downloads a model.

localAi.cancelDownload.description: Settings › AI on this PC: the accessible name of a download’s Cancel button.

localAi.rowName.description: Settings › AI providers: the first row, for AI that runs on this PC.

localAi.rowMeta.description: Settings › AI providers: what the On this PC row offers (no API key needed; drafts to check).

localAi.using.description: Settings › AI providers: the On this PC row once a model is downloaded; {title} is the model’s title.

localAi.setUpLabel.description: Settings › AI providers: the accessible name of the On this PC row’s Set up button.

localAi.setUp.description: Settings › AI providers: opens Settings at AI on this PC.

music.readFailed.description: Settings › More music: the list of downloadable tracks could not be read; {reason} is the error.

music.allDownloaded.description: Settings › More music: announced to screen readers after Download all.

music.removed.description: Settings › More music: announced to screen readers after Remove.

music.title.description: Settings › More music: the heading of the section that downloads more music for the library.

music.summary.description: Settings › More music: how many tracks can be downloaded and their size ("7.1 MB"). CC0 is the licence, never translated.

music.summaryDownloaded.description: Settings › More music: as the summary, with how many tracks are already downloaded.

music.downloadAll.description: Settings › More music: downloads every track not yet on this PC.

captionDownloads.script.japanese.description: Settings › Downloads for captions: the script a downloaded caption font covers, before "caption font".

captionDownloads.script.korean.description: Settings › Downloads for captions: the script a downloaded caption font covers.

captionDownloads.script.hanSc.description: Settings › Downloads for captions: the script a downloaded caption font covers.

captionDownloads.script.hanTc.description: Settings › Downloads for captions: the script a downloaded caption font covers.

captionDownloads.sizeUnknown.description: Settings › Downloads for captions: in a download’s row when its size is not known.

captionDownloads.scriptFont.description: Settings › Downloads for captions: what a download is; {script} is a script’s name ("Japanese").

captionDownloads.font.description: Settings › Downloads for captions: what a download is, when its script is not named.

captionDownloads.translationModel.description: Settings › Downloads for captions: what a download is (a model for offline translation).

captionDownloads.listFailed.description: Settings › Downloads for captions: reading the list failed; {reason} is the error.

captionDownloads.removeFailed.description: Settings › Downloads for captions: removing a download failed; {reason} is the error.

captionDownloads.title.description: Settings › Downloads for captions: the heading of the list of downloaded caption fonts and translation models.

captionDownloads.empty.description: Settings › Downloads for captions: nothing is downloaded. "Captions › Look › Text" names the panel, its tab and its section.

ai.confirmAlways.description: Settings › AI providers › Ask before a run that costs more than: ask before every run that costs money.

ai.confirmNever.description: Settings › AI providers › Ask before a run that costs more than: never ask.

ai.confirm.description: Settings › AI providers: label of a menu of amounts (US$0.10, US$1, US$5), Always ask or Never.

ai.service.description: Settings › AI providers: the kind shown on a row for a service at another address (one of More services).

ai.title.description: Settings › AI providers: the heading of the section of the user’s own AI services and API keys; also the list’s accessible name.

ai.lead.description: Settings › AI providers: what the providers do; <b> marks the word shown in bold.

ai.privacy.description: Settings › AI providers: the privacy line after a padlock.

ai.readFailed.description: Settings › AI providers: the list could not be read; {reason} is the error.

ai.empty.description: Settings › AI providers: no provider has been added.

ai.addressTitle.description: Settings › AI providers: tooltip of a service’s address.

ai.address.description: Settings › AI providers: before a service’s host name, such as openrouter.ai.

ai.noKey.description: Settings › AI providers: a service that needs no API key (Ollama, LM Studio).

ai.keyTitle.description: Settings › AI providers: tooltip of the masked key.

ai.key.description: Settings › AI providers: before the masked API key ("…3f9a").

ai.keyUnreadable.description: Settings › AI providers: after "Key" when the stored key cannot be decrypted on this PC.

ai.textModel.description: Settings › AI providers: before the model used for text tasks (a model id, never translated).

ai.transcription.description: Settings › AI providers: before the model used to transcribe sound.

ai.serviceCanDo.description: Settings › AI providers: what a service can do, followed by a full stop.

ai.testing.description: Settings › AI providers: shown while a provider’s key is tested.

ai.removeQuestion.description: Settings › AI providers: the question before a provider is removed; {name} is the provider’s name.

ai.testName.description: Settings › AI providers: accessible name of a provider’s Test button.

ai.test.description: Settings › AI providers: checks that a provider’s key works.

ai.editName.description: Settings › AI providers: accessible name of a provider’s Edit button.

ai.edit.description: Settings › AI providers: opens a provider’s form.

ai.add.description: Settings › AI providers: opens the form that adds a provider.

provider.moreServices.description: Settings › Add a provider: the fourth choice of the provider picker, for services at another address (OpenRouter, Groq, …).

provider.moreServicesHint.description: Settings › Add a provider › More services: the services it covers. The names are never translated.

provider.needName.description: Settings › Add a provider: the Name field is empty.

provider.needAddress.description: Settings › Add a provider: the service’s address is missing.

provider.needNewKey.description: Settings › Edit a provider: a service moved to another address needs its key typed again; also the hint under the key.

provider.needKey.description: Settings › Add a provider: the key is missing.

provider.badPrices.description: Settings › Add a provider: the prices typed are not numbers in range. US$ stays as it is.

provider.keepKey.description: Settings › Edit a provider: hint under the key; {key} is the masked key ("…3f9a").

provider.editTitle.description: Settings › Edit a provider: the form’s heading; {name} is the provider’s name.

provider.addTitle.description: Settings › Add a provider: the form’s heading.

provider.serviceCanDo.description: Settings › Add a provider › More services: the services covered ({services}, settings.provider.moreServicesHint) and what they can do.

provider.canDo.description: Settings › Add a provider: what the picked provider can do; {list} is its list of tasks, lower-cased.

provider.noTranscribe.description: Settings › Add a provider: after "Can do: …" for Anthropic Claude.

provider.service.description: Settings › Add a provider › More services: label of the menu of services (OpenRouter, Groq, …, Other address).

provider.resource.description: Settings › Add a provider › Azure OpenAI: the field for the name of the user’s Azure resource.

provider.resourceHint.description: Settings › Add a provider › Azure OpenAI: hint under the resource name.

provider.baseUrl.description: Settings › Add a provider › More services: the field for the service’s address.

provider.baseUrlHint.description: Settings › Add a provider › More services: hint under the address.

provider.apiKey.description: Settings › Add a provider: the key field’s label.

provider.unchanged.description: Settings › Edit a provider: placeholder of the empty key field; {key} is the masked key.

provider.notNeeded.description: Settings › Add a provider: placeholder of the key field for a service on this PC.

provider.hideKey.description: Settings › Add a provider: accessible name of the button that hides the typed key.

provider.showKey.description: Settings › Add a provider: accessible name of the button that shows the typed key.

provider.noKeyLocal.description: Settings › Add a provider: hint under the key for a service on this PC.

provider.serviceKey.description: Settings › Add a provider: hint under a service’s key.

provider.sentToAddress.description: Settings › Add a provider: after the key hint for a service.

provider.createKey.description: Settings › Add a provider: where to get a key; {host} is the provider’s web site (a link).

provider.sentTo.description: Settings › Add a provider: after the key hint; {name} is the provider (OpenAI, Google Gemini, Anthropic Claude).

provider.modelAzure.description: Settings › Add a provider › Azure OpenAI: the model field, which takes the name of the user’s deployment.

provider.model.description: Settings › Add a provider › More services: the model field.

provider.modelText.description: Settings › Add a provider: the model used for clean-up, translation, titles and the like.

provider.modelTranscription.description: Settings › Add a provider: the model used to transcribe sound.

provider.openaiTranscription.description: Settings › Add a provider › OpenAI: hint under the transcription model. Model names are never translated.

provider.geminiTranscription.description: Settings › Add a provider › Google Gemini: hint under the transcription model.

provider.prices.description: Settings › Add a provider: opens the price fields. US$ stays as it is.

provider.input.description: Settings › Add a provider › Prices: the price of input tokens.

provider.output.description: Settings › Add a provider › Prices: the price of output tokens.

provider.unknownPrices.description: Settings › Add a provider › Prices: the model has no price in the bundled list.

provider.noData.description: Settings › Add a provider › OpenRouter: checkbox that asks OpenRouter to route only to hosts that keep no data.

provider.goesTo.description: Settings › Add a provider: where the key and text go; {host} is a host name in bold, or "the address above".

provider.addressAbove.description: Settings › Add a provider: in "Your key and the text you send go to …" before an address is typed.

provider.checking.description: Settings › Add a provider: the button while the saved service is checked.

provider.saveAndCheck.description: Settings › Add a provider › More services: saves and checks the key and how the service answers.

provider.addButton.description: Settings › Add a provider: saves a new provider.

updates.check.description: Settings › About › Updates: the action button that looks for a new version.

updates.download.description: Settings › About › Updates: the action button that downloads a found update; {version} is its number.

updates.downloading.description: Settings › About › Updates: the action button while the update downloads (not pressable).

updates.restart.description: Settings › About › Updates and Home’s title bar: restarts Flown to install the downloaded update.

updates.title.description: Settings › About: the heading of the updates block.

updates.lastChecked.description: Settings › About › Updates: when the last check ran; {when} is a time ("10:42") or a day and time ("30 Oct, 10:42").

updates.downloadingLabel.description: Settings › About › Updates: the accessible name of the download’s progress bar.

updates.auto.description: Settings › About › Updates: checkbox for automatic updates.

updates.hint.description: Settings › About › Updates: how automatic updates work.

updates.notes.description: Settings › About › Updates: opens the release notes of the update; {version} is its number. The notes themselves are not translated.

updates.dayTime.description: Settings › About › Updates: when the last check ran on another day; {day} is a date ("30 Oct"), {time} a time ("10:42").
